title: The Beginning of Breaking the Pattern
next_chapter_hook: The three-month countdown officially begins—and on the other side of the temporal rift, a figure imprisoned for years gazes through the cracks of fate, watching the impending upheaval.

text.content:
Chen Ji's voice echoed through the secret realm, the pressure of the Heavenly Eye suddenly dissipating—yet somewhere far beyond the Thirty-Third Heaven, eyes that crossed through time slowly opened.

Those eyes had no pupils, only a chaotic pallor, within which countless scenes circulated: dynasty rises and falls, sects flourish and perish, the life and death of countless cultivators. All fates, in its gaze, were merely a chess game already played.

Deep within the secret realm, the air was thick with an oppressive weight. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his face as calm as an ancient well, yet an unprecedented sharpness burned in his deep eyes. That sensation of being watched felt like a thorn in his back, yet he appeared completely unaware.

Beside him, Ye Qing frowned, lowering her voice: 'It's watching you.'

Chen Ji淡淡'un一声, the corner of his mouth curling into a playful arc: 'I know.'

dialogue.content: 'If it wants to look, let it look its fill.' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, 'After hiding for so many years, it finally dares to show itself—I thought it could truly remain forever hidden beyond the Thirty-Third Heaven, an uninvolved bystander.'

text.content:
A chill ran through Ye Qing's heart. She had witnessed Chen Ji's countless calculations and schemes, yet never had she heard him speak in such a tone—it was a defiance bordering on provocation, as if the one he faced was not the lofty Will of Heaven, but merely a discarded piece on the chessboard.

'Are you declaring war on it?' she asked.

Chen Ji offered no answer, merely raising his gaze toward that void that seemed to pierce through everything, his eyes deep as an abyss.

At that moment, a thunderous rumble erupted from the depths of the secret realm. The ground shook violently as countless runes gushed from the earth, intertwining in the air to form a massive formation diagram. At the diagram's center, a blinding pillar of light shot upward, piercing the heavens!

Ye Qing's face turned pale: 'This is... the secret realm's core is awakening!'

A gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, and a smile curled his lips: 'Better late than never. Since it wants to watch a show, let's give it a spectacular one.'

choice.prompt: The secret realm's core awakens, containing enormous fortune and peril. How will Chen Ji navigate this turning point?

choices.text: Seize the initiative and take the lead
choices.description: Move first in the secret realm's upheaval, seizing the core fortune and grasping fate's initiative in one's own hands.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the secret realm's core inheritance, with strength surging dramatically
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the secret realm's defense mechanism, suffering backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji's figure flickered, darting toward the light pillar's source like a specter. Ye Qing felt her eyes blur, and his figure had already vanished.

'This guy...' She gritted her teeth and followed, her heart a mixture of astonishment and admiration.

Chen Ji never fought a battle without certainty. Since he dared to strike first, he must have already devised a foolproof strategy.

choices.text: Stay still to counter movement, observe quietly
choices.description: Let Ye Qing probe ahead first, while observing the situation from the shadows, waiting for the optimal moment to strike.
choices.visible_reward: Discern all hidden forces within the secret realm
choices.risk_hint: May allow other forces to seize the opportunity first

text.content:
Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, his gaze sweeping across the gradually awakening formations and restrictions around him.

'No hurry.' He said calmly, 'Since the secret realm's core has revealed itself voluntarily, there must be a reason. Let's first understand the layout here, then decide.'

Ye Qing nodded slightly, yet secretly felt chills—this secret realm's core power was probably far more terrifying than they had imagined.

Just then, a hoarse and icy voice rang out from the void: 'Chen Ji, do you truly believe a mere mortal body can shake Heaven itself?'

Ling Yuan's figure emerged from the darkness, bizarre black mist coiling around him. His aura had become even more profound and terrifying, like an ancient beast awakening from the depths of an abyss.

'Old thing, you're not dead yet?' Chen Ji turned, his gaze sharp as a blade.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan coldly smiled, his voice carrying a hint of mockery: 'This old man has died once already, now merely reborn through borrowed flesh. As for you, speaking so boldly at such a young age—do you truly believe that obtaining the Tianji Record Fragment allows you to challenge Heaven?'

text.content:
Upon hearing this, Chen Ji did not grow angry; instead, he laughed. That smile was calm and at ease, as if he had heard the most hilarious joke.

'Reborn through borrowed flesh?' He slowly stepped forward, each step striking Ling Yuan's heartstrings, 'You think that by betraying the Tianji Record's inheritance and selling yourself to the so-called Heavenly Eye, you can exchange it for immortality?'

Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply as he shouted: 'You... how could you possibly know all this!'

dialogue.content:
'How do I know?' Chen Ji laughed lightly, his smile carrying a playful charm, 'You think you're the only candidate for the Tianji Record? You think you were chosen as Heaven's favor?'

He paused, his gaze blazing, 'Wrong. You are merely one of the discarded pieces arranged by the Heavenly Eye across generations—a whetstone specifically used to test those who come after.'

text.content:
Ling Yuan's face changed dramatically, the black mist around him churning violently. Clearly, Chen Ji's words had pierced the deepest wound in his heart.

Ye Qing watched from the side, her heart pounding with fear. She had followed Chen Ji for so long, yet never seen him so bluntly tear open someone's scars. This was no longer mere provocation, but naked humiliation.

But Ling Yuan was no ordinary person. He was an old monster who had lived for hundreds of years, his temperament as unyielding as bedrock. After a brief moment of loss of composure, he quickly regained his composure.

dialogue.content: "So what if what you say is true?" Ling Yuan sneered. "Whether chosen or abandoned—I've already transcended the mortal realm, rising above the laws of Heaven's Way. And you... are nothing but an ant struggling for the Heavenly Fate Value!" He raised his hand, pointing at the pillar of light. "Do you see that? That is the legacy from the core of the secret realm—the supreme opportunity that should have belonged to the successive inheritors of the Tianji Record. Now, it is about to fall into my hands!"

text.content: Before the words could finish, a majestic force erupted from the pillar of light. A illusory figure slowly emerged from within—a middle-aged man with refined features and profound, deep eyes. Chen Ji's body trembled, his eye sockets suddenly turning red. "M-Master...?" The figure turned its head, gazing at Chen Ji, its eyes filled with relief and tenderness: "Ji'er, you've finally arrived."

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's remnant soul slowly spoke, its voice carrying the vicissitudes of time: "This secret realm was the final test your master left for you. And Ling Yuan..." It turned to look at Ling Yuan, its gaze instantly turning ice-cold, "is merely a traitor who betrayed the sect and sold out to the Heavenly Way those years ago."

text.content: Ling Yuan's face turned ashen, his voice sharp: "Chen Nian! You've been dead for many years, nothing but a wisp of residual soul! If you hadn't been biased back then, passing the Tianji Record to a废物 instead of me, how would Ling have been driven to this point!" When Chen Ji heard the word "废物," his gaze instantly turned cold. He stepped forward slowly, positioning himself in front of Chen Nian's remnant soul. "废物?" he said softly, his voice terrifyingly calm. "Ling Yuan, do you know... that the one Master chose back then... was indeed a废物?"

With these words, everyone present was shocked. Ye Qing's eyes widened, gazing at Chen Ji in disbelief. Ling Yuan stood frozen in place, his expression utterly精彩. Chen Nian's remnant soul smiled faintly and nodded: "Indeed. The Tianji Record's legacy has never belonged to geniuses. Only废物 can bear the Heavenly Secrets. Because only those not blessed by fate can see through the truth of destiny."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji is about to reveal his true identity and origins. This is the pivotal moment that will change everything.

choices.description: Revealing to everyone that he is Chen Nian's biological son, the true inheritor of the Tianji Record, not some worthless servant废物.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly raising his head, staring directly into Ling Yuan's eyes. "Ling Yuan, do you want to know why Master chose a废物 back then?" He spoke word by word: "Because that废物 was Master's biological son." With these words, heaven and earth shattered.

choices.text: Maintaining mystery: only revealing being the legitimate inheritor
choices.description: Only proving to be the legitimate inheritor of the Tianji Record, without revealing the specific relationship with Chen Nian, maintaining strategic ambiguity.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to obtain the complete legacy
choices.visible_reward: Retaining trump cards and keeping enemies uncertain about one's true strength

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, not directly responding. "Whether I am a废物 or not, what does that have to do with you?" he said casually. "What matters is—the Tianji Record recognized me as its inheritor, not you." Ling Yuan's face turned gloomy, yet he couldn't refute for a moment. Because at this moment, the power from the core of the secret realm was slowly gathering towards Chen Ji.

Ling Yuan finally couldn't contain himself any longer. He let out a roar, the black energy around him surging violently, transforming into countless black chains that swept towards Chen Ji. "Whatever your identity, today you must die here!" Chen Ji remained motionless, allowing those chains to approach him. Just as the black energy was about to touch his body, a golden light burst forth from the core of the secret realm, completely incinerating all the black energy!

Ling Yuan spat out blood, flying backwards, his face full of disbelief. "This... this is impossible! Why would the core of the secret realm acknowledge you!" Chen Ji walked slowly towards the pillar of light, each step trampling upon Ling Yuan's dignity. "Because I am Chen Nian's sole inheritor," his voice calm as water. "And you... are merely that loser."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly extended his hand, touching the pillar of light. In that instant, a brilliant golden light enveloped his entire being. Within that golden light, Chen Ji's aura began to ascend at an incredible speed. Gold Core, Yuan Ying, Transcending Divinity... within a few breaths, his cultivation had crossed heights that ordinary people couldn't achieve in a lifetime! "Is this... the true power of the Tianji Record?" Ye Qing murmured, his eyes filled with shock.

text.content: Chen Nian's remnant soul nodded slightly, his eyes filled with relief: "Ji'er, the last thing your master could do for you was to wait here, guarding this place, awaiting your arrival. Now, the legacy from the core of the secret realm has entirely returned to your hands. The road ahead... must be walked by yourself." "Master!" Chen Ji stepped forward, wanting to grasp that gradually dissipating figure. Chen Nian smiled faintly, reaching out to touch Chen Ji's head: "Don't be sad. Master's mission is complete. The battle ahead... is only truly beginning."

As the words fell, Chen Nian's remnant soul completely dissipated, leaving only a gentle voice echoing in Chen Ji's ears: "Remember, the true essence of the Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in... changing destiny." Chen Ji remained silent for a long time, finally slowly nodding: "Disciple... understands." He turned around, his gaze blazing, looking towards that void that had always been watching him—that was the direction of the Eye of Heaven's Way.

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Heaven's Way." Chen Ji's voice echoed in the secret realm, carrying an unprecedented determination. "I know you're watching." He raised his head, staring directly at that void: "From this day forward, I, Chen Ji—formally declare war on you."

text.content: As the words fell, a thunderous rumble suddenly came from outside the secret realm. The originally clear sky suddenly darkened, countless dark clouds gathering from all directions, forming a colossal eye that blotted out the heavens. That eye had no pupil, only a chaotic pallor, exactly the same as that eye beyond the Thirty-Third Heaven. Ye Qing's face turned pale: "It... it's descended directly!"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji smiled. That smile carried a hint of contempt, a trace of provocation, as if he were facing not a supreme Heavenly Dao Will, but an overreaching clown.

"Is this all the fanfare?" He shook his head, his tone full of disappointment, "I thought you would appear in person. Turns out it was just a projected phantom... It seems even you aren't confident enough to defeat me face-to-face."

text.content:
Within that massive eye, chaotic white light began churning violently. Clearly, Chen Ji's words had angered this lofty existence.

A majestic voice emanated from the eye, like thunder rolling across the heavens: "An ant dares to speak of defying heaven?"

Before the words even finished, a vast pressure poured down from the sky, like an invisible mountain crushing down toward Chen Ji!

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, letting that pressure fall upon him. His robes fluttered wildly, and the protective spiritual light around him trembled ceaselessly, as if it might collapse at any moment.

But he still didn't retreat a single step.

"Defy heaven?" He laughed softly, "All I want, Chen Ji, is to take back what belongs to me. The Tianji Record is mine, the secret realm is mine, and the fate of this world... shall be written by me!"

text.content:
The moment his words fell, a brilliant golden light erupted from within Chen Ji. That golden radiance broke through his protective spiritual light, standing in opposition to the massive eye in the sky.

The two forces collided mid-air, producing a deafening roar. The entire secret realm trembled violently, as if it might collapse at any moment.

Ye Qing was knocked backward by the aftershock, her face full of shock: "This... Is this truly the power a human can achieve?"

The golden light and the pressure of the Heavenly Eye stalemated for a moment before simultaneously dissipating.

The massive eye in the sky narrowed slightly, as if reassessing this ant who dared challenge it.

"Interesting." That majestic voice rang out again, "It seems you do have some ability... But do you think, with just this, you can contend against the Heavenly Dao?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji offered no answer. He slowly raised his hand, and a page of a yellowed scroll appeared in his palm—that was the first page of the Tianji Record.

"I know what you're thinking." He said softly, "You're thinking that as long as you eliminate me, the Tianji Record will fall back under your control."

He smiled, that smile carrying a hint of madness, "But you've forgotten one thing—the Tianji Record has already acknowledged a master. Even if you kill me, it will choose the next challenger. Endlessly, until... you die."

text.content:
At these words, a trace of fluctuation finally flickered within that massive eye.

"Are you threatening me?"

"Threatening?" Chen Ji shook his head, "No, I'm merely stating facts."

He returned the Tianji Record fragment to his body, his gaze calm as still water: "The war between us began the moment I obtained the Tianji Record. This war will not cease due to either side's will—until a victor is determined."

The massive eye fell silent for a moment, the pressure slowly subsiding.

"Very well." That majestic voice rang out once more, "Since you insist on seeking death, this one will grant your wish."

The words fell, and a massive crack split open in the sky beyond the secret realm. Within that fissure, a towering structure loomed vaguely—it was a massive altar, covered in诡异的符文.

"In three months, the Corpse Bone Altar opens." That voice was cold and authoritative, "At that time, this one will be waiting for you there."

dialogue.content:
"Three months..." Chen Ji murmured, a complex gleam flickering in his eyes.

He knew of the Corpse Bone Altar. That was a forbidden ground from ancient times used to sacrifice to the Heavenly Dao, opening once every ten thousand years. Legend had it that countless bones of ancient powerhouses lay buried there, their grudges intertwined with the will of the Heavenly Dao, forming an unbreakable curse.

But at the same time, there also lay hidden...

text.content:
Ye Qing suddenly cried out: "The Corpse Bone Altar! That's not the legendary..."

"Correct." Chen Ji nodded, his voice calm, "There is sealed within a power that can completely destroy the Heavenly Eye—but it is also where the Heavenly Eye is at its strongest."

He turned to look at Ye Qing, a determined gleam in his eyes: "This is a high-stakes gamble. Either I completely defeat the Heavenly Eye, or... I die there."

Ye Qing opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but found that any words were pale and powerless at this moment.

She had never seen Chen Ji look so serious. Those eyes that always carried a hint of world-weariness were now burning with a flame she had never seen before—that was the resolve to burn one's bridges, the desperation of returning from the brink of death.

"I'm going with you." She finally said, her voice firm.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji glanced at her, a smile tugging at the corner of his lips: "The Demonic Path's mist can indeed conceal the aura of the Tianji Record. Following me does increase our odds somewhat."

He paused, his tone shifting: "But the journey to the Corpse Bone Altar is extremely dangerous. If you come with me, you might... not be able to return."

Ye Qing coldly laughed: "You think I'm someone who fears death?"

Chen Ji shook his head: "I know. But I'm even more afraid of dragging you down."

text.content:
Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then suddenly smiled. That smile carried a hint of bitterness, a trace of relief.

"Chen Ji, do you know? From the moment I met you in the Southern Frontier, my fate has been bound to yours." She said softly, "If you die, what's the point of me living?"

Chen Ji was stunned, a flicker of emotion passing through his eyes.

"You foolish woman..." He helplessly shook his head, but didn't refuse again.

Just then, a feeble voice came from nearby: "Chen... Chen Ji..."

Chen Ji turned to look, only to see Ling Yuan struggling to climb up from the ground. His body was covered in wounds, and his aura was chaotic to the extreme.

"You... you may have gained the upper hand today, but the journey to the Corpse Bone Altar will be your death!" Ling Yuan gritted his teeth, his eyes full of hatred, "The Heavenly Eye's power far exceeds your imagination!"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slowly walked toward Ling Yuan, each step pressing down on the other's heartstrings.

"Ling Yuan, after following the Heavenly Eye for so many years, what have you gained?" He looked down at this once-arrogant nemesis, "借用体重生? Heh, you're merely a chess piece for it."

Ling Yuan's face turned ashen, yet he couldn't refute.

Chen Ji said indifferently: "I'll give you a chance. At the Corpse Bone Altar in three months, I permit you to follow—of course, as my... stepping stone."

text.content:
A flicker of humiliation passed through Ling Yuan's eyes, but there was more of a complex expression.

"You... aren't you afraid I'll stab you in the back?"

Chen Ji smiled, that smile carrying a hint of mockery: "If you have the guts, go ahead."

He turned around, his back facing Ling Yuan: "But I'll give you a piece of advice—in three months' time, instead of plotting how to betray me, you'd better think about how to survive before the Heavenly Eye."

"After all..." He glanced back at Ling Yuan, "Without you, who will prove that I'm stronger than the Heavenly Eye?"

Ling Yuan's expression changed multiple times, finally turning into a long sigh.

"You win." He said quietly, his voice carrying a hint of desolation, "From the moment you obtained the Tianji Record back then, I was utterly defeated."

Chen Ji said nothing, only quietly gazing at that gradually dissipating sky. The phantom of the Heavenly Eye had completely vanished, leaving only the prophecy of the Corpse Bone Altar's opening in three months.

"Three months..." He murmured, "That's enough."

Deep within the secret realm, the formation patterns gradually dimmed, and the pillars of light began to fade. The core opportunities had all been absorbed by Chen Ji, and this space was slowly collapsing.

Ye Qing walked to Chen Ji's side and asked softly: "What do we do next?"

Chen Ji raised his head, gazing toward the exit of the secret realm. The light streaming in from there was no longer the dim glow of the secret realm, but the real sunlight of the outside world.

"Let's get out first." He said, "Three months' time, not long, not short. I have many preparations to make."

Ling Yuan silently followed behind the two, saying nothing. This once-arrogant nemesis now resembled a wandering ghost without direction.

Chen Ji paid him no attention, only walking slowly toward the secret realm's exit. In his mind, though, Chen Nian's remnant soul's words before dissipating kept echoing: "The true essence of the Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in... changing destiny."

"Changing destiny..." He murmured, a determined gleam flickering in his eyes, "This is what I must do next."

The moment the three stepped out of the secret realm, the outside sky had already returned to calm. But Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm.

The Heavenly Eye had already taken notice of him. The Corpse Bone Altar three months later would be an ultimate showdown determining the course of destiny.

And before then, he had far too much to do—enhancing his strength, rallying allies, gathering intelligence... and finding that younger sister who was taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

"Chen Nian..." Chen Ji murmured, a hint of gentleness flickering in his eyes, "Wait for me. In three months, your brother will definitely come to rescue you."

Sunlight fell upon Chen Ji, stretching his shadow long.

The three-month countdown officially began.

And within these three months, he would accomplish an unprecedented transformation—from a schemer hiding in the shadows to a rebel daring to declare war on heaven.

This was the beginning of breaking the局.

And also... the final chapter of destiny.
